notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo and Live hot fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Prop Haunt Patch Notes: 9/2/2025[/h1]

Thank you everyone for playing and providing feedback and bug reports! I'm pushing out some small fixes that have been reported over the past couple of days. As always, please leave feedback and bug reports either in the Steam Discussions or on the Discord! 

🔊 Audio

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Investigator was able to hear the Ritual Orbs
[*] Fixed an issue where the Zap sound was global and ignored audio settings.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Zap sound would spam when zapping a Ghost.
[/list]

🎮 Gameplay

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Ritual Orb/Room destruction would incorrectly slow the Investigator if off the camera.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ghosts were able to use their Ultimate while stunned.
[*] Fixed a bug where all Ghosts were teleported during room destruction, even if they weren't in the room.
[*] Fixed an issue where control settings were not loaded correctly during the tutorial. 
[/list]

🖥️ UI / UX

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Teleport screen would not disappear sometimes.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Loading screen would not disappear sometimes.
[*] Disabled the functions to Unready players in the Lobby when a new player joined. This was causing confusion.
[/list]

notes.title: Prop Haunt Is Available Now!
notes.content:
[p]It’s been a long road, and I’m proud to finally announce...[/p][h2]
Prop Haunt has arrived in Early Access! [/h2][p]
After years of solo development, my first game is available now on Steam. Looking back at how far I’ve come to reaching this point, it’s a bit unbelievable. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/8e0340ef38534246428c14e5b5ffd0a82e2c7d20.png"][/img][i]The first rendition of ghosts vs. the final version. Truly a long way![/i][/p][p][/p][p]Visual changes are not the only thing that saw updates. With the help of friends and players, I’ve been able to take feedback from all over. This feedback has helped me redefine features, maps, hauntings, and game mechanics from big system changes to small, but important UI changes. [/p][p][/p][p]When I say I couldn’t have done it without your help, I mean it from the bottom of my heart! Thank you to everyone who has provided feedback and joined the community. Prop Haunt is what it is today directly because of you. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/33d9d9e703b271e6c053f0806c309bfe8724ef91.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Now, this does not mean development is finished just yet. There is still a road to 1.0, which I still plan on marching towards with player feedback. Keep an eye out for updates and changes during this time. Prop Haunt still has more to offer! 

Until then, here is everything you can expect in Prop Haunt’s Early Access Launch and beyond.[/p][p][/p][h3]👻[u]Current Early Access Features[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Four Ghosts to play.[/p][/*][*][p]2 Maps to play.[/p][/*][*][p]Public and Private lobby support.[/p][/*][*][p]In-game voice chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Destroy the majority of rooms to win as a Ghost. Scare and interfere with the Investigator to distract them.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent Ghosts from destroying rooms by reporting haunts and zapping Ghosts.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔎[u]Release Patch Notes[/u][/h3][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Investigator Ability: Flip 180. Tired of those pesky Ghosts flying behind you while you’re scanning? Use your Flip 180 to surprise them.[/p][/*][*][p]New orb SFX when being destroyed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed the Tutorial to allow Possession use anytime.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, during scanning, using and stopping zap would hide ghosts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Ghost's trail colors weren't displaying correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Ghost scores were not showing on the end screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in the Tutorial where the last task for the Ghosts wouldn’t clear the Ghost World UI after haunting a warehouse prop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the scan ability didn’t switch to cooldown tracking when used and still had enough AP.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🗺️[u]Post EA Roadmap[/u][/h3][list][*][p]More maps.[/p][/*][*][p]More Haunts.[/p][/*][*][p]More tools for the investigator.[/p][/*][*][p]More ways for the Ghosts to scare and interfere with the Investigator.[/p][/*][*][p]Procedural prop generation to prevent memorization and increase replayability.[/p][/*][*][p]Role matchmaking system.[/p][/*][*][p]Metaprogression (Ghost and investigator levels that unlock passives/abilities).[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboards.[/p][/*][/list][p]You can pick up Prop Haunt today for $14.99! [/p][previewyoutube="axMngRosTus;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Run into a bug or have feedback? Join the community [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/wj2qDv4BXY" buttoncolor="#673172"]Discord[/url][/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/wj2qDv4BXY" buttoncolor="#673172"] [/url]to report. Thanks again, and happy haunting, everyone! [/p][p]-Silent Forest Games🌲[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960220/Prop_Haunt/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.content:
[p]Another playtest is wrapped up, and big changes for the Prop Haunts demo come with it! Before I dive into all the changes you can expect, please take my heartfelt THANK YOU! None of these changes would have been possible without player feedback during the playtests and the public demo.

Even though the playtests are officially over, as I prepare for the Early Access release (I can’t believe August 29th is already almost here), that doesn’t mean changes aren’t coming. There is still so much more to add to Prop Haunt before 1.0, such as new maps, new haunts, and more! 

I’ll be looking closely at player feedback and reports to continue to make Prop Haunt the best it can be with your help. Join the official Discord to report. Thank you again![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/611fdc15d699ab5eac3ab3babd7870471c15dd58.jpg"][/img][i]New map in the works: Police Department[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Find the patch notes below and enjoy the biggest demo update to date![/p][h1]Prop Haunt Demo Updates[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]👻 Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New Haunt[/b]: Facing Haunt. Haunted Prop will turn to face the camera while actively being watched.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Haunt:[/b] Object Swap. This Haunt will replace the Prop with a similar but different Prop. (E.g., one kind of chair with a different kind of chair). Props that can be haunted this way randomize their starting Prop, giving some replayability to each level.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Haunt:[/b] Toggle Lights. Some lights are now randomized on or off at the start of the match. This Haunt will toggle it to the other state.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Ghost ability:[/b] Possess. Possess a Prop, then Haunt it. When your Prop gets reported, it triggers a jump scare for the investigator.[/p][/*][*][p]Match search now lists all lobbies sorted in the following order:[/p][list][*][p]Public joinable[/p][/*][*][p]Public Full[/p][/*][*][p]Private[/p][/*][*][p]In Match[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New interactive tutorial for Ghosts and Investigators[/p][/*][*][p]Camera controls moved to WASD and QE, away from mouse movement.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]⚖️ Balance Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added a short 2-second cooldown for Haunts.[/p][/*][*][p]Haunt’s abilities are now charge-based and customizable in [i]Match Settings[/i]. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed limit of Haunts per room.[/p][/*][*][p]Investigator Scan ability is now instant, and the Investigator can switch between rooms while activated to hunt Ghosts.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts are now visible while in Haunt or Possess mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts now have a trail behind them when moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the stun effect for ghosts by half. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of Influence needed to perform Rituals. Sorry Ghosts, the wins were happening a little too easily.[/p][/*][*][p]New [i]Match Settings[/i] in the settings menu for customization:[/p][list][*][p]The number of Haunt charges Ghosts have.[/p][/*][*][p]If Prop possession is always usable or only without Haunt charges.[/p][/*][*][p]Investigator difficulty. Easy setting for the investigator makes Ritual Orbs take more power to be destroyed. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A timer is displayed in the Investigator warehouse to let players know how long they have until they are auto-teleported back to the ritual site.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🎵UI and Audio[/b][/h2][list][*][p]New Icons for Ghost Abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]New Icons for Investigator abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]New UI for Ghost to better display game state. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI conflicts on the scoreboard.[/p][/*][*][p]New UI system for Ghost and Investigators.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved location of mute button on scoreboard.[/p][/*][*][p]All players can now hear the Scan Ability sound. It is now loudest if in the same room with you.[/p][/*][*][p]The lobby now has a spectator role, so full parties can easily be held between the investigator and the ghosts. This is [i]not[/i] a spectator role in-game. Just a place to change roles in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the font with a more legible one.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved flow of UI in the Lobby. WorldUI Pins disappear to make selecting options easier.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed bug where the game wouldn’t return to the lobby if the hunter left mid-match.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed translation errors.[/p][/*][*][p]The demo acceptance UI is fixed and only appears once now as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where controls would incorrectly disappear on the bottom right.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the resize haunt would reset after a while.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where spamming E to sit down at the Investigator computer would break controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Props that weren’t haunting correctly in the kitchen, bathroom, and living room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with crates hiding the mouse not clearing correctly when found.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the Investigator sometimes couldn’t interact with the crates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where lobby doesn’t clear from search when starting a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the last player to join didn’t get set as Investigator.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with cooldowns on warehouse Props were not working.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with friends list not showing friends for non-host players in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the crash that happens when returning to the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where changing master volume wouldn’t change other audio volumes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the Investigator's ability power was reset to 0 when getting back on the cameras from the warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the Ritual Orbs were visible to the Investigator when looking at the computer screen with the camera pointed at an orb.[/p][/*][*][p]No longer able to start a match with 1 player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Ghosts were able to body block the report action, preventing the Investigator from reporting haunts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Ghost’s could see the world indicator for the Investigator when the lights are out[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where using your ultimate as a Ghost while it was on the global cooldown would apply a permanent cooldown, preventing any usage of the ult even if you had charges. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that spam populated the Haunt Detected warning, which would also overwrite the Missing USB Device error, leading to confusion. Now, nothing will change if a new haunt is detected and the warning is already present.[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960220/Prop_Haunt/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Prop Haunt Demo Update
notes.content: [h3][b]👻 Features & Additions:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Clearer Tutorials. [/p][list][*][p]The tutorials are now interactive.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Voice Chat and Mute option.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Haunt for Ghosts.[/p][list][*][p]The Prop slowly turns towards the camera while the Investigator is in the same room as the Prop.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Additional ways to scare the Investigators, both on and off-camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Fake Haunts.[/p][list][*][p]The camera now indicates to the Investigator when there is an active Haunt in a room.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts can “Fake” a Haunt to make the indicator appear in a room even if there isn’t a Haunt happening. This ability only has a cooldown and does not use ability power cost.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The selected Ghost and its color remain between matches now. No need to keep changing back to the color you want after a match.[/p][/*][*][p]Switched to charge-based Haunt system:[/p][list][*][p]Players are no longer limited to 1 Haunt per room.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts now start with 3 charges of their Haunt ability, and use them to haunt props. One haunt = one charge.[/p][/*][*][p]One charge returns every 30 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ghosts are now visible when in Haunt mode to increase risk vs reward.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]⚖️Balance Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Investigator Scan ability is now instant. The investigator can switch cameras while it’s active, and ghosts are slowed down during it. [/p][/*][*][p]The required AP to destroy the orb is now scaled with the number of Ghosts in a match.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts now teleport back to the room where they used their ultimate after haunting a prop in the warehouse.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎧UI/Audio Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Scan ability sound is now global. Loudest when in the room with players and quieter when being used in a different location.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby now has a spectator role so that full parties can more easily change between Investigator and Ghosts. This is not a spectator role for in-game, and only works in the Lobby.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🛠️Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where the game wouldn’t return to the lobby if the hunter left mid-match.[/p][/*][*][p]Translation errors fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Controls no longer incorrectly disappear on the bottom right.[/p][/*][*][p]Resize Haunt no longer resets after time passes.[/p][/*][*][p]Spamming E to sit down at the Investigator computer no longer breaks controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed props that weren’t haunting correctly in the kitchen, bathroom, and living room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with crates hiding the mouse and not clearing correctly when found.[/p][/*][*][p]The investigator can now always interact with the crates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Lobby not clearing from the search before starting a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the last player to join didn’t get set as the Investigator.[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldowns on warehouse props, which allowed for Ghosts to spam Haunts on them, are now fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with friends list not showing friends for non-host players in the lobby.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🪲Known issues being worked on:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The game crashes when the host plays a Ghost and ends the match. This doesn’t happen if the host played the Investigat[b]or.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you have feedback or run into a bug, please report it on the official [url="https://discord.com/invite/wj2qDv4BXY" style="button" buttoncolor="#59258d"]Discord[/url] server. Thank you and happy haunting![/p]

notes.title: Prop Haunt’s First Roadmap & Post-Next Fest
notes.content: [p]That’s a wrap on the Steam Next Fest! First, I’d like to say thank you to everyone who watched the stream, wishlisted and played the demo. I couldn’t do this without you. [/p][p][/p][p]This was my first ever Next Fest and I gotta say, I am happy with the results. During the event, a peak of 50 people watched the stream, we had a community game night and I’ve doubled the total wishlists. Again, thank you to everyone who participated![/p][p] I also got great feedback and have been working hard on the future of Prop Haunt’s demo and launch. notes.title: Major Update for Prop Haunt’s Demo!
notes.content:
Hello Ghouls and Investigators! 

I have big news, as you might’ve seen from the title, Prop Haunt’s demo just got its biggest update yet, and it’s all thanks to YOU! These changes come directly from the second playtest, from all the feedback we received from it. 

Prop Haunt will also be participating in the June Next Fest, now with a demo that’s bigger and better than ever, all thanks to your input!

Of course, if you run into any bugs, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wj2qDv4BXY][b]Discord[/b][/url]to report them. Thank you and happy haunting!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]📑Major Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented multiple localizations
[*] Scan ability for Investigator implemented
[list]
[*] 1.5 minute cooldown
[*] Ghosts have to hide or be zapped when they become visible.
[*] The investigator is prevented from changing cameras after Scan is activated.
[*] Ghosts can’t use their abilities during the scan.[/list][*] Added Notifications and a countdown for the scanner
[*] Added new tutorial messages to drive players through their first match
[*] Lobby global voice chat
[*] Team-based voice chat in-game
[/list][h3]🖥️Gameplay & UI Changes[/h3][list][*] Updated “Charge Room” to “Ritual” 
[*] The pause menu now appears over the rest of UI in game
[*] Pressing escape now closes the teleport menu
[*] Ultimate orb now indicates if it can be used or not and is shared between Ghosts.
[*] Updated all abilities UI components to reflect whether they can be used or not based on cooldowns/ability power
[*] Teleport menu: grayed out destroyed rooms so players can’t teleport to them
[*] Added player list for lobby[/list][h3]👻Ghost Changes[/h3][list][*] Ghosts now get influence for haunting props in the Investigator’s warehouse
[*] Ghosts are now visible when charging the orbs
[*] Reduced rate at which ghosts grow in size and realness
[/list][h3]⚖️Balance Changes[/h3][list][*] Reduced rate of AP gain for the Investigator  
[*] Reduced camera turn rate
[*] Reduced rate of miasma growth on haunted props
[*] Reduced the initial cost of Investigator’s ultimate from 5AP to 1AP
[/list][h3]💀Misc. [/h3][list][*] Added sound effects for when the room is destroyed
[*] Feedback when zapping a ghost has been added
[*] Added music to the main menu, lobby, and house.
[/list][h3]🐛Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*] Fixed bug where opening the pause menu before the match started would break controls for ghosts
[*] Haunting the window lamp in the kitchen is fixed.
[*] Haunting the Reading light in the living room is fixed
[*] Haunting the Spray bottle in the bathroom is fixed
[*] Fixed bug where ghosts haunt ability wouldn’t be blocked when teleporting into the room where the Investigator is
[*] Fixed issue where the second time the mouse was haunted in the investigator warehouse, it didn't clear the effects 
[*] Fixed issues with cooldowns not applying to haunts in the Investigator warehouse
[*] Fixed issue with being able to hold down Q/E and spam the failed ability noise
[*] Fixed lobby performance issues
[*] Fixed issue with AP continuing to drain after leaving the Investigator warehouse
[*] Fixed the world UI pin showing on the customization screen
[*] Mouse/box sounds in Investigator Warehouse audible for everyone fixed
[*] Some props were not accruing Miasma correctly.
[*] All props that were affected by this are now fixed
[*] Kicking a player in the lobby now correctly opens the spot for another player to join
[*] Preventing input before loaded into the match should fix some control issues
[*] Hearing other ghosts getting zapped is fixed
[*] Mouse now appears at end game correctly
[*] Ghost zapped audio spam is fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome To Prop Haunt
notes.content:
Hello ghouls and investigators!

Welcome to my first official Devlog!

Before I begin, huge thanks to everyone who jumped into Prop Haunt’s very first playtest and gave feedback. I couldn’t (and wouldn’t want to) do this without your help!

While I parse through feedback, bugs and features in preparation for the upcoming demo, here’s a brief intro to what Prop Haunt is and what’s in the works. Enjoy!
[h2]
Prop Haunt’s early beginnings.[/h2]

Now, if you’ve played ‘I’m on Observation Duty’ and ‘Prop Hunt’, you might have noticed some similarities between those and Prop Haunt. You’d be right, the idea was born while playing with friends when one of them said, [i]“Why hasn’t anyone made a game combining this and Prop Hunt yet!?”[/i].

In the middle of Udemy UE4 courses and a desire to make a multiplayer game, I said: [i]“Why don’t we?”[/i].

Prop Haunt was born! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/c70285fa0467a9b925ac199cbc291e1b20c7abcc.jpg[/img]
Before I could make my own ghosts, yeah..it started like that. Thanks marketplace!

Development began in earnest in April 2024. It started as a family affair, my wife joining me to make the very first house level. Eventually, I’d be working alone again due to time constraints, but with help from the marketplace place I’d make due.

Being one person, sometimes you have to just work with what you have to get anything done at all.
[h2]
Prop Haunt’s Growth[/h2]

As with most early stages of anything, learning was the biggest challenge. I was determined to learn how to do the rigging and animation on my own. Meanwhile, knowing art is not my strongest suit, I outsourced concept and technical art like shaders and 3D models to companies and friends, then rigged/animated them myself. No more Pac-Man ghost!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/a83b754cae5ac64f67ee4f43a386005e56b195c5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/1c8e4709f0405b608f41e9a149e13d94d3d1fc7e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/93d393f8abf9e5229a94c28f837bf79c5cacb432.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/9246240913f69726c7a72bca17f9b2d86793260b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/7ca42a081ea7c23db59b62cd4c5ddc7798baf515.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/d6b91bffc50b0b0fc9830ab2b29ea2d822feed18.png[/img][/url]

Not a bad upgrade from the marketplace ghost, huh?

And of course, there is the challenge of gameplay. This is something ongoing and not just changing with my input, but players as well. Recently, the first playtest ended, during which I was lucky enough to receive vital and well-thought-out feedback about gameplay.

From cursor suggestions, balance issues for both ghosts and investigators, messaging clarity and more, I’ll be working on in preparation for the upcoming demo on [b]April 18th[/b].

[h2]Prop Haunt Now
[/h2]
Which brings us to the current state of Prop Haunt. Still in the early stages of development, there are bound to be many changes, especially with player feedback. Something I’m constantly looking for and gathering. As a labor of love, this game just isn’t possible without you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/92e2e4033c213c1b6ddf575958914e889ea52537.png[/img]
Based on feedback from the playtest, I’ll be busy making changes for the demo, including: 
[list]
    [*]Rebalancing powers for Ghosts and the Investigator.
    [*]Re-visiting the Level length.
    [*]Better tutorial and clarity for game mechanics, such as what ultimate's do, the Investigator's job, and more. 
[*]General polishing before the demo for a better experience and more feedback before early access.
[/list]
The future also holds several improvements and additions as well. Later this month, you can expect these updates for starters.
[list]
    [*]Hunter trap system
    [*]“Trap” props so that when the Ghosts try to haunt it, it stuns them.
    [*]Balancing and bug improvements from demo reports. To give feedback, please join our community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/wj2qDv4BXY][b]Discord[/b][/url]. 
[*]Second map created, lobby updated to change floor based on selected map.
[*]Steam achievements.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/c828ab78ffa4150b6cad6c1660d37d839c545482.png[/img]

Thank you for checking out Prop Haunt! I’m very excited to be working, improving and building it with you. Join the community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/wj2qDv4BXY][b]Discord[/b][/url] and keep your eyes open for more updates and news on the demo, coming [b]April 17th.[/b]

Happy hauntings and I’ll see you in-game soon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/56f24262eed0cd9c35dac56cac63d92bba8212aa.png[/img]
